scope: linux_configuration/features: setup_dns_blocker.sh (gateway/gateway-off), setup_wireguard_ssh.sh, lib/{dns_gateway,dns_units,wg_gateway,wg_firewall,wg_sshd}.sh, warp_window.sh (PC), warp_home.sh (laptop, no root)
